integrity_notes: The mathematical statements are supported by a finite, self-contained proof and an exact rational checker.
Literature comparison supports a provisional priority judgment, not exhaustive or independently certified originality.
No external scientific audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The three-year seed crops are prescribed, deterministic and repeated indefinitely, with a unique stationary predator cycle.
The predator recurrence is affine rather than a nonlinear recruitment or Nicholson–Bailey population law.
The consumption function is a model proxy; unrestricted parameter sets do not ensure a nonnegative seed budget each year.
The result does not establish evolutionary fitness, field applicability, or stochastic or transient stability.
title: A sharp three-crop chronology switch under lagged seed predation
